crossRefs.note: They went up out of Egypt, and came into the land of Canaan, to Jacob their father.

people.name: Canaan
people.line: Ancient region; descendants of Ham; promised to Abraham's descendants

people.name: Egypt
people.line: Ancient nation; Israelites enslaved there; plagues and Exodus

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: They went up out of Egypt, and came into the land of Canaan, to Jacob their father.
translations.bsb: So the brothers went up out of Egypt and came to their father Jacob in the land of Canaan.
translations.kjv: And they went up out of Egypt, and came into the land of Canaan unto Jacob their father,
translations.asv: And they went up out of Egypt, and came into the land of Canaan unto Jacob their father.
